title: What is it Actually Like to Intern at Blue Bird?
summary: Real Projects, Real Responsibility: What It’s Actually Like to Intern at Blue Bird
body_markdown:
Real Projects, Real Responsibility: What It’s Actually Like to Intern at Blue Bird


“My intern work mirrors the full-timers’ — and it moves the needle.”


In this episode of the Bird’s Eye View Podcast, host Will (Marketing Intern) sits down with Amari (IT Intern) and Carly (Manufacturing Engineering Intern) during their final week of Blue Bird Corporation’s 10-week summer internship program. They lift the curtain on what it’s really like to work inside a leading school bus manufacturer. From managing high-stakes cyber security tasks to working hands-on inside an innovative manufacturing plant, our interns don’t watch from the sidelines—they make a real impact. Turn up the volume to hear about their cross-functional teamwork, executive mentorship experiences, and advice for future applicants!
